summary: BlockRips added Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay and Google Pay deposits for pack credits, the first competitor card-payment launch we've seen, right as we plan Coinflow. On Pump.fun, Phygitals packs replaced Collector Crypt packs in Gachapon on 24 Oct, and one tracker says spending there keeps falling. Solflare Packs talk was busy but mostly from Solflare Guardians and small accounts; the top organic-looking post was a rare Charizard pull by @kev0x13. Collector pain this cycle: a 7.2M-card PSA grading backlog, fake slabs, and Bandai event tickets selling out in seconds.

top_posts.text: Deposits just got a HUGE upgrade. Top up pack credits with Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay or Google Pay, & withdraw straight to your bank. Launch boost: 2x Rip Points on every pack rip paid with the new payment methods. 48hrs only.
top_posts.why_it_matters: A direct competitor now takes card, Apple Pay and Google Pay for pack rips. Same move we're planning with Coinflow, so watch how they message it.

top_posts.text: What exactly are people saying about @Solflare Packs? People are getting curious about it, especially those who love Pokémon cards and other collectibles. Think about it. You spend $25 on a Starter Pokémon Pack, open it in your @Solflare wallet, and find out which card you got.
top_posts.why_it_matters: Highest-engagement Solflare Packs post of the day; explains the $25 Starter Pack in plain words.

top_posts.text: you hit a 100× pull. now prove it. new on decard: pull receipts. rip a @Collector_Crypt pack, hit "share pull" and get a card-grade receipt with the slab, grade, cert, insured value, best bid, pop, and how many times your pack price you pulled.
top_posts.why_it_matters: Shareable 'pull receipt' cards are a format people engage with (16.5k impressions). Fits our shareable album.

top_posts.text: Gachapon activity on pumpfun app has tapered off significantly since initial launch, with spending declining further following replacement of Collector Crypt packs with Phygitals packs on October 24. Daily Gachapon spending has fallen from highs of $8m during initial CC launch
top_posts.why_it_matters: Pump.fun swapped Collector Crypt for Phygitals in Gachapon. Our partner lost a distribution channel; Solflare becomes a bigger CC outlet.

top_posts.text: found a new Pokemon NFT activity on #Solana. yep, it's $CARDS, my favorite concept where every NFT is backed by a physical Pokemon card. the new platform offers 3 Pokemon packs to new users, so i decided to try it myself. today i finally opened all 3 packs
top_posts.why_it_matters: Free-starter-pack onboarding by another Collector Crypt front end is getting quotes and replies; compare with our free demo.

top_posts.text: 7.2 million cards. That's how many submissions PSA still had in its grading backlog as of October 20. The number is actually improving, down from 8.2 million just two weeks earlier.
top_posts.why_it_matters: Grading wait is a real collector pain. Our cards come already graded by PSA or Beckett.

Slab. Grade. Cert number you can check.

post_ideas.idea: Grading wait: speak to the PSA backlog pain without naming numbers
post_ideas.draft_copy:
Waiting months for grading?

Cards in Solflare Packs are already graded by PSA or Beckett.

Open. See the slab. Keep it, sell it back, or ship it home.

1933: a pack had one piece of gum and one card.

Today: you open a pack in your wallet and the card is a real graded slab.

Some things don't change. You still don't know what's inside.

sources_note: X search via the x connector, posts from 2026-10-25 09:00 UTC to 2026-10-26 09:10 UTC, 7 searches. Engagement numbers are copied from the X API at scan time. Many Solflare Packs posts come from Solflare Guardians or small accounts with near-zero impressions, so read volume as campaign activity, not organic demand. Spam, giveaway farms and token shill posts were skipped. Creators already in collector-base.csv were excluded. The Robinhood Chain item is a third-party claim.
